rules: fresh_session: true
prior_messages: 0
parent_session_id: null
memory_enabled: false
shared_artifacts: false
unique_session_and_request_ids_enforced
with_arm_exposure: candidate plugin plus declared common_tools only
without_arm_exposure: baseline zero candidate plugin and common_tools only
context_sha256 digest pinning against frozen plan
definition_sha256 digest pinning for every exposed tool schema
no unconsumed cursor, pagination truncation, or ambiguous tool list
exact bipartite inventory match against frozen plan
raw_output retained as verbatim UTF-8 string or explicit null
output_sha256 cryptographic binding
local deterministic re-scoring from raw output using objective validators
zero trust in external pass/fail markers or self-reported model claims
durable sqlite append-only AttemptJournal with immutable triggers
lifecycle state machine: prepared -> dispatched -> running -> terminal
disconnect and unknown attempts reconciled with source_ref
denominator conservation: cancelled and failed attempts retained in analysis
explicit diagnostic retry using retry_of preserving primary attempt prominence
full cost settlement reconciliation across all dispatched attempts

scope: Software release candidate validation and rigorous methodology specification only; not proof of generic plugin superiority or unassisted external adoption.
